newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SOCCER-LATVIA BEAT ESTONIA 3-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATVIA BEAT ESTONIA 3-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Latvia conceded an early goal but rallied to beat neighbours Estonia 3-1 in a World Cup European group four qualifier on Sunday.
Indrek Zelinski gave Estonia the lead in the fifth minute and the home side grimly hung on to their advantage until the interval.
Latvia's Vladimir Babitches equalised in the 53rd minute and Estonia suffered a further blow eight minutes later when midfielder Viktor Alonen was sent off for his second bookable offence.
Aleksandr Jeliseev, who had just come on as a substitute, made it 2-1 for Latvia in the 78th minute and an own goal by Estonia's Marek Lemsalu four minutes from time sealed the home side's fate.

"We are very pleased and the team came out of a difficult situtation," Latvia trainer Janis Gilis said. "We knew that Estonia would make the most of free kicks and corners and we were looking out for them."
It was Latvia's second win in six group four games. They are fourth with seven points, well behind Scotland (14 from seven games), Austria (10 from five) and Sweden (nine from five).
Defeat sent Estonia to the bottom of the standings with four points from six games and an inferior goal difference to that of Belarus.
A crowd of 1,600 watched the match.
